claims: Cori Close is the Michael Price Family UCLA Women's Head Basketball Coach.
Cori Close has held the position of Michael Price Family UCLA Women's Head Basketball Coach since April 2011.
Cori Close led the Bruins to their first-ever NCAA Final Four appearance in 2025.
Cori Close was named the 2025 National Coach of the Year (AP, Naismith, USBWA, WBCA).
As of April 2026, Cori Close has over 300 wins at UCLA.
Cori Close led UCLA to the 2025 Big Ten Tournament Championship.
Cori Close led UCLA to the 2025 Final Four.
Cori Close previously served as associate head coach at Florida State.
Cori Close played at UC Santa Barbara.
The 2025-26 coaching staff includes Associate Head Coach Tony Newnan.
The 2025-26 coaching staff includes Assistant Coach Tasha Brown.
The 2025-26 coaching staff includes Assistant Coach Soh Matsuura.
The 2025-26 coaching staff includes Assistant Coach James Clark.
The 2025-26 coaching staff includes Assistant Coach Michaela Onyenwere.
